# Chimera II OS Command Cheat Sheets

This catalog organizes common Linux/POSIX, Unix/BSD, Windows CMD/PowerShell and macOS command names into one searchable Chimera namespace.

GNU Coreutils documents the standard GNU file, shell and text utilities. citeturn0search2turn0search10 Microsoft maintains an alphabetical Windows command reference for command-line automation. citeturn0search0turn0search8 FreeBSD documents Unix commands, shells, account management, permissions, processes and manual-page usage in its Handbook. citeturn0search1turn0search4 Apple documents Terminal command execution and its Command Line Tools. citeturn0search3turn0search16

## Use

The cheat sheets are reference data, not a claim that every listed executable is installed. Chimera resolves commands to native implementations when available and uses compatibility adapters when installed and authorized. English names remain valid; Arabic aliases can map to the same canonical namespace.

## Security

Account, storage, service, networking, security and administrative commands remain subject to Koronos and Aegis authorization. Proprietary platform binaries are not copied merely because their command names appear in the catalog.
